maintenance_led.reason: Sells cannabis consumer products and operates RISE dispensaries; consumables used up, not repair or maintenance of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Revenue comes from consumers and patients buying cannabis at retail stores and wholesale to other dispensaries, not government.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own brands, cultivation and RISE retail store openings across 14 markets, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Consumers can easily switch among cannabis brands and dispensaries; products are consumer goods with low switching costs.
